_about: EXERCISES (motion.js, docs/motion.md): the standard training set, each made of MOVEMENTS (assets/people/movements.json) -- one `movement`, or a `sequence` gone through in turn (alternating sides) -- repeated `reps` times at a `tempo` (times multiplied: 1 as the movements are written, below 1 faster). `works`: what it trains.

squats.about: feet hip-width apart, sit back and down until the thighs are level, stand up

lunges.about: a long step forward, the back knee down toward the floor, back up; then the other leg

toe touches.works: the backs of the legs, the lower back (a stretch)

high knees.works: hip flexors, the heart (running on the spot)

push-ups.works: chest, shoulders, the backs of the arms

shoulder press.works: shoulders, the backs of the arms
